note: Single source of truth for the GT monogram. Consumed by the React component, the SVG asset writer and the rasteriser so the three can never drift. Coordinates are chosen so that at a 16px render every stroke edge lands on a whole pixel: the 64-unit grid divides by 4, so multiples of 4 stay crisp in a browser tab.

paths.role: G — open ring, aperture on the right at ±30°
The shared stroke: spur of the G, crossbar of the T
